data.heading: Where it started
data.description: A hard deadline against the whole storefront estate, on a stack that could not carry peak-sales traffic.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: A three-month platform shutdown put all storefront revenue at risk, while 8 to 10 second loads and checkout failures cost peak-sales conversions.

blocks.title: No decision framework
blocks.body: Incompatible schemas across the legacy platform and WooCommerce, a zero-loss move of 1.38M records, 31,500 warranty records in custom EAV structures, and 30+ performance-degrading plugins. Traditional ETL and manual QA could not meet the date.

blocks.title: Agivant’s Role
blocks.body: Migration and data engineering across platform move, headless architecture, and production rollout

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Forward Deployed Engineers embedded across order management, marketing, brand, and support. Discovery two weeks, prototype and schema mapping three weeks, then production sprints and a brand-by-brand rollout with automated go-live gates. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: Data Migration agent
blocks.body: Schema-aware ETL from the legacy platform and WooCommerce, with retry and audit trails.

blocks.title: Data Validation agent
blocks.body: Source-to-destination integrity checks on products, customers, orders, and warranty metafields.

blocks.title: SEO and URL Mapping agent
blocks.body: Automated 301 redirect rules and drift monitoring after cutover.

blocks.title: QA and Regression agent
blocks.body: Automated journey tests across browse, cart, checkout, and account, plus visual regression per brand.

rows.value: Klaviyo, Loop, Yotpo, Signifyd, Statsig, Triple Whale, DataGrail

rows.label: Production agents
rows.value: Data Migration, Data Validation, SEO and URL Mapping, QA and Regression

rows.label: Controls
rows.value: Human approval at go-live, role-scoped access, staged per brand

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: A monolith with manual scripts, siloed brand databases, and no automated QA.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: An agent layer feeding unified pipelines into Shopify Plus, headless APIs, Next.js and Hydrogen frontends, and automated go-live gates.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: At the first brand cutover, the Data Migration agent moved 768K profiles overnight. Validation flagged 0.3% metafield mismatches, SEO generated 4,200 redirects, and QA ran 847 checkout scenarios, all before sign-off. A three-week data sprint plus a one-week QA cycle became a 48-hour pipeline.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: All 10+ brands live before the shutdown, with zero revenue-loss downtime.

blocks.title: Reusable asset
blocks.body: The Commerce Migration Blueprint reuses 80%+ of agent configs on later moves, and a new storefront joins the support cockpit in under two hours. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Parallel workstreams across 10+ brands on one deadline, a shift to scoped admin access, and 31,500 warranty records restructured into Shopify metafields with no customer-facing disruption.
"We needed a partner who could rescue our storefronts fast and set us up for the long term. The AI-accelerated approach did both."
